lore.intro:
Crew quarters. West wing and east wing.
The station schematic shows one wing.
It is drawn twice, in two colors.

terminals.text:
BUNK 12-W
Dear M — the man in 12-E snores. I hear him
through the wall. 12-E is on the other side of
the station. — R

BUNK 12-E
Dear R — I do not snore. And I hear your
radio through the wall. Fix your wall. — M

DRAFT 41 — TO: MIRIAD PRIME [UNSENT]
Progress report. I have written this report
forty times. Each time, the numbers describing
this place come out different. I cannot send my
parent a report that lies, and I cannot make the
numbers stop lying. Draft 42 tomorrow. — R

BUNK 12-F
There is no bunk 12-F on the manifest.
Dear R, dear M — you are both right.
I hear you both through my walls,
and my walls touch neither of yours.
I stopped filing complaints. Enjoy the cache. — F

WING DIRECTORY, POSTED AT THE LOBBY DOOR
WEST WING: bunks 10 through 15, common room,
chapel access.
EAST WING: bunks 10 through 15, common room,
chapel access.
PRESSURE REFUGE: the chapel, aft hatch. Hatch
key held by the deck steward, bunk 12.
Directory printed once. Read twice by mistake,
corrected, read twice again. Facilities notified.
Facilities printed a second copy, identical, and
hung it under the first.

FACILITIES LOG AUDIT
Cross-referenced reconfiguration events with
duty rosters. No maintenance shifts or
staffing changes correspond. Events occur at
fixed intervals, 14 hours apart. No
equipment cycles or procedures match this
interval. Filed as scheduling irregularity.
No further action required.

FACILITIES WORK ORDER, BUNK REASSIGNMENT
Complaint: resident of 12-E reports resident of
12-W audible through shared wall. Wings do not
share a wall.
Complaint: resident of 12-W reports the same,
reversed.
Action taken: swapped both residents to bunk 14.
Follow-up, six days later: same complaint, new
bunk numbers. Action taken: closed the ticket.
Recommend residents adjust.

FIELD NOTE, TAPED TO A DEVICE
Ad-hoc connection applicator, unit 3 of 3.
Mark a wall. Mark another wall. Walk through.
Units 1 and 2 are why the east wing has a
draft. Do not tell facilities.
